title: State Automatic Renewal Law: Recurring Subscription Consent and Cancellation Requirements
summary: A state automatic renewal statute adds requirements for how sellers obtain consent for a recurring subscription and provide an easy online cancellation mechanism, often described as click-to-cancel. It binds businesses that offer auto-renewing subscriptions to consumers in the state.
full_text: This state automatic renewal law sets requirements for sellers that enroll consumers in a recurring subscription. Sellers must obtain express informed consent before charging, present clear automatic-renewal terms before purchase, and provide a simple online cancellation mechanism so a consumer can cancel a recurring subscription as easily as they signed up. The requirements apply to businesses that offer auto-renewing subscriptions to consumers in the state, alongside the federal negative-option framework.
